text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we need to run a short enablement roundtable next week for a handful of accounts showing sign-of-friction. Goal: 45min compact session to cover onboarding gaps + renewal signal triage.

Jared: +1. Which time window are we targeting? prefer overlap for EMEA + PST customers.

Priya: I can do late CET (16:00 CET) which is morning PST. Elena — are you available?

Elena: 8:30am PT works for me on Tue/Wed.

Maya: Awesome. Thinking of two 45m slots: one Tue 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT and one Wed 10:00 CET / 01:00 PT (for APAC-friendly). Which do we prefer for the customer cohort?

Jared: Tue slot seems best for these mid-market accounts. Wed is rough for EMEA.

Priya: Agreed — Tue 16:00 CET. I'll take facilitator duties if Maya can run the agenda.

Maya: I can run agenda. Volunteers for note-taking and action items? quick show of hands. :raised_hand:

Elena: I can do notes and follow-up items.

Jared: I’ll handle the live demo of the Dedicated migration checklist (5–7min).

Maya: Draft agenda below — short and focused. please flag edits.

```
45m compact enablement roundtable (Tue)
- 0–5m: Welcome + goals (Maya)
- 5–15m: Onboarding health quick-check (key blockers, infra, perms) (Priya)
- 15–25m: Demo: Dedicated migration checklist highlights (Jared)
- 25–35m: Quick wins + config fixes we can push SAME DAY (Elena)
- 35–44m: Renewal risk signals & next actions (Maya)
- 44–45m: Close + assign owners
```

Elena: Suggest we add a 1-slide pre-read for customers with account health summary (1 pager). saves time.

Maya: Good call. Priya can you assemble the pre-read export (health score, top 3 tickets, token spend trend) and drop in the meeting thread by Monday EOD?

Priya: Will do. ETA Mon 17:00 CET. I’ll include a short CSV of usage anomalies.

onboarding-bot: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/polls/abc123 — votes so far: 3 (Tue 16:00 CET)

Jared: Also, we should capture feedback inline using the short form: https://forms.redwood.ai/enablement-feedback (1–2 min). I’ll paste post-call.

Maya: For staffing FYI — two accounts flagged with moderate renewal risk (health score < 60) and slow ticket response. We should prioritize time with them in the first 15m.

Elena: Noted, I’ll open the two tickets before the call and add runbook suggestions in the notes.

Priya: Who owns the follow-up play for quantization/latency config? that came up last month and is still open.

Maya: That’s on Platform team handoff — Jared to capture and assign to eng-platform backlog.

Jared: Yep will create issue post-call with labels: customer:high-touch, triage:performance.

Maya: Cool. Quick logistics: please RSVP on the poll, add session to your calendar once confirmed, and add any customer-specific asks under this thread. I’ll draft the invite with the pre-read link Monday morning.

Elena: RSVP'd.

Priya: RSVP'd and pre-read will be uploaded to the thread.

Jared: RSVP (tentative) — will confirm after I land a patch.

Maya: Thanks team. reminder: keep the session lean — we want concrete next steps and owners. I’ll ping ops for recording + transcript. :thumbsup:

onboarding-bot: Recording enabled for event on confirmation. Reminder set for 30m before start.

Maya: End — will update thread with final invite + attendee list once poll closes.
